title: Manasik Payments & Invoices — How Payments Work
text: How do payments and invoices work in Manasik? Payments, invoices and billing: the Payments page is your agency's money diary. Every amount a traveler pays you — cash at the counter, a bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa — is recorded against their booking, and Manasik adds it up for you: the booking's Paid figure, the Balance still due, and the total your agency has received (Total received and This month, by each method). Recording payments works on every plan. Instalment plans are part of the Standard and Pro plans: the Instalments page lists every instalment promised across all bookings, oldest due first, each marked Paid, Partially paid, Due or Overdue — work down that list for follow-up calls. Full guide: https://www.getmanasik.com/guide/payments
